svg.title: Green Angle Over White
svg.desc: Interpretive SVG after inspecting a public publisher PDF plate. Approximate contour and interpretive palette. Six-edged green chevron over a white rectangular support. Relief depth and cast shadows omitted. Plate page51 follows caption page50. Palette refinement (2026-11-09): specific source-image review of green; interpretive screen colors, not calibrated to original paint.
svg.metadata: Reference:https://archive.org/download/EllsworthKellyLastPaintings_201811/EllsworthKellyLastPaintings.pdf#page=50; visually inspected2026-10-27; editable interpretation, not a facsimile.
